configuration.precision: FP32 weights; FP16 CUDA autocast; explicit FP32 log-mel, Gemma audio attention and CTC head
configuration.audio_attention: FP32 island preserves original mask and invalid-logit sentinel; no fallback
configuration.base_loading: BF16 CPU deserialization then FP32, as upstream; not BF16 inference
configuration.decoder: greedy CTC argmax, collapse repeats, drop blank; use_lm=False
configuration.chunk_policy: contiguous <=30s, keep every sample including short tail; no VAD/quiet splitting
configuration.preprocessing: shared CPU float32 mono mean + scipy resample_poly to 16k; no trimming
configuration.warmup: first unfinished clip of each pass, separately excluded from measured predictions
configuration.latency_scope: synchronized waveform-to-text including chunking/features/transfer/CTC; excludes preparation/load/warmup
